research.kubejs.thaumic_create.root.body: This chapter holds Create research. After mastering the crucible, purchase stone transmutation research with aspect points. Scanning brass makes its research puzzle available.
research.kubejs.thaumic_create.create_di: Add one Praecantatio and one Ordo to a boiling crucible, then drop in one block of ordinary stone to produce diorite.
research.kubejs.thaumic_create.create_an: Add one Praecantatio and one Aer to a boiling crucible, then drop in one block of ordinary stone to produce andesite for Create machinery.
research.kubejs.thaumic_create.create_gr: Granite retains the fire of the depths. Add one Praecantatio and one Ignis to a boiling crucible, then drop in one block of ordinary stone.
research.kubejs.thaumic_create.brass.bod:
Scanning a brass ingot with the thaumometer makes this research available. Obtain research notes and solve the puzzle with Metallum, Permutatio and Praecantatio anchors.

After completing the research, add one Permutatio, one Praecantatio and one Metallum to a boiling crucible, then drop in a lead ingot to obtain one Create brass ingot.
research.thaumic_create.plate_thaumium.b:
The Create mechanical press turns one ingot into one plate.

Research cost: 4 Metallum + 2 Praecantatio. Study the corresponding metal first.

The press uses the research of its placer. Right-click an existing unowned press to claim it. Plate production requires the owner to purchase this research.
research.thaumic_create.plate_void.title: Void Metal Plate
research.thaumic_create.plate_void.body:
The Create mechanical press turns one ingot into one plate.

Research cost: 4 Metallum + 2 Praecantatio + 2 Vacuos. Study the corresponding metal first.

The press uses the research of its placer. Right-click an existing unowned press to claim it. Plate production requires the owner to purchase this research.
research.thaumic_create.essentia_adapter:
Connect TR essentia tubes to the small rear socket and Create fluid pipes to the pale front port.

Default flow: TR to Create. Sneak-right-click reverses conversion. The internal buffer holds 64 units of one aspect; 1 essentia unit equals 125 mB. A Create pump moves the fluid.

Requires Thaumium Plate research. Puzzle settings are editable.
research.thaumic_create.essentia_tank.bo:
A Create-style multiblock storing one essentia aspect. Ordinary fluids and mixed aspects are rejected.

64 units per block; four blocks hold 256. Footprints: 1×1 or 2×2, up to 10 blocks tall. Maximum: 2×2×10, holding 2560 units.

Use Create pumps and pipes, and an adapter for TR tubes. Requires Essentia Adapter research. Drain before dismantling; splitting follows Create tank rules.
research.thaumic_create.engine.title: Essentia Engine
research.thaumic_create.engine.body:
Supply Potentia to the base and connect shafts to the sides of the upper part.

Hold right-click on the front panel to select 1–128 RPM. Fuel is paid every 10 ticks, preserving fractional units. Speed changes apply at the next paid interval. Starts at 8 RPM for 0.5 Potentia per 10 ticks. Aspect selection is not enabled.
research.thaumic_create.art_of_alchemy.r: This is a reference to The Art of Alchemy. Complete the original research in the Alchemy chapter; no additional research or purchase is required here.
